query_text: what temperature can food be accepted at

messages.content: what temperature can food be accepted at

message.content:
If you mean **food holding/acceptance temperature for safety**, cold food should be **40°F (4°C) or below**, and hot food should be **135°F (57°C) or above**.[1][3][4]

If food has been sitting in the **danger zone** between **40°F and 140°F**, it should generally not be left out for more than **2 hours**; if the room temperature is above **90°F**, the limit is **1 hour**.[1][2][5]

If you meant the **cooking temperature** for a specific food, the safe minimum internal temperature depends on the item—for example, poultry must reach **165°F**, ground meat **160°F**, and beef/pork/veal/lamb steaks or roasts **145°F with a 3-minute rest**.[1]
